prompt.project_info: Create a warm golden-hour close-up candid selfie portrait indoors.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult blonde woman with long golden hair and platinum highlights, blue eyes, prominent natural freckles, calm direct gaze, wearing an opaque pale-yellow or cream floral top with secure shoulder coverage.
prompt.composition_elements: Close-up selfie with head resting lightly on right hand, slight head tilt, dark softly blurred domestic background and white paneled door, eyes and freckles sharp.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Side golden-hour sunlight from the left creates distinct facial and background shadows, warm ethereal intimate summer atmosphere, natural pores and no heavy filtering.
prompt.technical_specs: 4K photorealistic portrait, shallow depth of field, sharp eyes and freckles, candid smartphone look, realistic skin texture and warm color grade.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A close-up candid selfie portrait of an approved adult blonde woman with long golden hair and lighter platinum highlights, fair skin with prominent natural freckles, piercing light-blue eyes, and a calm contemplative direct gaze. She wears an opaque pale-yellow or cream floral top with secure shoulder coverage and rests her head lightly on her right hand. The background is dark and softly blurred with hints of a white paneled door. Golden-hour sunlight from the left creates distinct shadows and warm highlights. Use 4K photorealistic portrait detail, sharp eyes and freckles, natural pores, shallow depth of field, and an unfiltered sun-kissed summer mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, late-teen ambiguity, corset, bustier, spaghetti straps, lace trim, exposed chest, soft pout sexualization, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
